# Badge

A short label for a status, category or count, next to what it describes.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Accessible first</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-badge--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:accessible-first;mode:light" title="Badge examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-badge--docs">Open Badge in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-badge--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:accessible-first;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Accessible first:** A status label with an icon and a word, in a clear rectangle. Not color alone, and not a pill.

- **Use it when:** A state people scan for in a list or table, or a small category label.
- **Not when:** A message people must read (alert or toast), or an action (a button).

Instead:

- [Alert](./alert.md): A message, not a label.
- [Button](./button.md): Something to press.

## Why it works this way

Badge looks the way it does because of 5 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Badge, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-accessibility-count"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How many signals carry each meaning?</b><code>accessibility.count</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Three: color, icon and word</div><p>Never color alone.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Badge</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>neutral</b>: A waiting state, such as an application saved to resume later, with an icon and a word.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>success</b>: A finished task, with a filled icon and a word.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>warning</b>: A risk people can still fix before they finish, with an icon and a word.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>danger</b>: A failure that blocks the task, with a filled icon and a word; an alert says how to fix it.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Alert: destructive</code> <code>Item: muted</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">4</div><small>Badge decisions would reopen</small><p>and 1 answer that follow from it: <b>Status and messages</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-scenarios-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How long is one visit?</b><code>scenarios.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">One sitting</div><p>An application is finished in one sitting, or saved and resumed.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Badge</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>neutral</b>: A waiting state, such as an application saved to resume later, with an icon and a word.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Badge decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-components-values"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>When does a component get another look?</b><code>components.values</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Only when the meaning changes</div><p>One clear way to do each thing.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Badge</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>info</b>: Neutral covers news with nothing to do: one clear way to do each thing.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Badge decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-outcomes-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>Which outcome matters most?</b><code>outcomes.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Completion without errors</div><p>Completion without errors is the measure.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Badge</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>success</b>: A finished task, with a filled icon and a word.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Alert: default</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Badge decision would reopen</small><p>and 2 answers that follow from it: <b>Links and actions</b>, <b>Form steps and errors</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-outcomes-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is a costly mistake?</b><code>outcomes.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">A task that fails</div><p>A failed form can cost someone a benefit.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Badge</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>warning</b>: A risk people can still fix before they finish, with an icon and a word.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>danger</b>: A failure that blocks the task, with a filled icon and a word; an alert says how to fix it.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: secondary</code> <code>Button: danger</code> <code>Alert: destructive</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Badge decisions would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The status is a word; color and icon add to it, never replace it. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add badge
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Badge reads 13 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Badge's tokens to change Badge alone.
